units: <cite ref="Menachot 39b:3">Men. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>עשה גדיל ופוֹתְלֵיהוּ מתוכו</he> make a fringe and twist a part of it; <cite ref="Yevamot 5b:2">Yeb. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>ופָתְלֵהוּ</he>. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 15 (expl. <cite ref="Q02165"><he>פתיל</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 15:38">Num. XV, 38</cite>) <he>והוא צריך לפָתְלָן</he> and one must twist them.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> (play on <he>נפתלי</he>) [read:] <he>שהיו מְפוּתָּלִים ד״א שהיו פותלין על ע״ב ניר</he> they (the sons of Naphtali) were perverted; another explanation, they twisted (wove curtains) on seventy two leashes, v. <cite ref="N00787"><he>נִיר</he> IV</cite>.

senses.gloss: same, trnsf. to pervert. [Sifré Deut. 308 מפתלו, read with Yalk. ib. 942 מפסלו, v. פָּסַל.]—Part. pass. מְפוּתָּל; pl. מְפוּתָּלִים, מְפוּתָּלִין. Gen. R. l. c. (some ed. מוּפְתָּלִים Hof.), v. supra.
